banner.title: PulseKRN 2.8 is here
banner.body: New Update Control (block and unblock Windows Update) and Lite Mode to make Windows faster - every change can be undone.
banner.link_desc: The full list of new tools and fixes in this release.

announcements.title: Welcome to PulseKRN news
announcements.body: Announcements from the PulseKRN team will pop up here: new features, important fixes and tips for keeping your PC healthy. Update checks run quietly every 3 hours, so you always hear about new versions first.
announcements.link_desc: Downloads, release notes and the latest news.

announcements.title: New: Repair Center
announcements.body: Windows Repair is now the Repair Center. Run a Health Scan to get a score and clear next steps, then fix only what is broken. Every repair asks before it changes anything, and nothing is ever removed from Windows.
announcements.link_desc: What each Repair Center tool does and when to use it.

announcements.title: New: Wipe & Reset
announcements.body: Pick exactly which files, browser data, saved logins, Wi-Fi networks, app data or accounts to erase. Nothing is selected until you choose it, you confirm before anything is erased, and Windows itself is never touched.
announcements.link_desc: How Wipe & Reset works and what it can erase.

announcements.title: New: Lite Mode & Update Control
announcements.body: Make Windows lighter with Lite Mode (pick a level or single tweaks) and pause Windows Update for a few days when you need speed. Everything PulseKRN changes can be reverted exactly.
announcements.link_desc: How they work and how to undo them.
